# al-Kindi — Digital Product Studio

> A digital product studio working from interfaces to smart contracts.

al-Kindi is a small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design. The studio designs brands, ships products, and engineers onchain systems that feel natural to use and easy to understand. Some days we draw screens, some days we deploy contracts; most days, we do both.

Sound reasoning. Elegant engineering.

Legal entity: Alkindi, Unipessoal LDA. Based in Lisbon, Portugal.

## Services

Here are the services the studio offers.

### 01. Smart Contract Development

Smart contracts written for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).

### 02. Smart Contract Audits

Rigorous security reviews for Ethereum Virtual Machine smart contracts.

### 03. Web App Development

Production web applications with clean architecture. From first prototype to codebases that survive scale and hand-offs.

### 04. Web Design

Sites that read clearly and load fast. Calm layouts, considered typography, attention to the surfaces people actually touch.

### 05. User Interface Design

Components, design systems, prototypes. The screen-level execution that turns flows and decisions into product surfaces.

### 06. User Experience Design

User research, journey maps, information architecture, usability testing. The studio frames the problem clearly so design and engineering can solve the right one.

### 07. Brand & Visual Identity

Names, marks, type systems, tone of voice. Identity systems with a quiet confidence, ready for product surfaces.

### 08. Copywriting

Brand voice, marketing copy, UI microcopy, long-form content. Words that carry the same care as the interfaces they live in.

### 09. Graphics & Digital Art

Original illustration, motion pieces, generative work. Visual systems with a point of view, not stock-feeling filler.

### 10. Technical Advisory

Architecture reviews, Web3 integration strategy, technology decisions. Honest trade-offs, not deliverables for their own sake.

## About al-Kindi

A small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design.

The studio prefers clear scope, honest dialogue, and work that can stand on its own without big words. Sometimes that means adding a feature; sometimes it means simplifying and removing noise.

The studio is not chasing trends. The aim is to help clients build something useful, consistent, and well-made.

## Origin of the name

al-Kindi — Abu Yusuf Yaʻqub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi — was a 9th-century Baghdadi polymath who wrote on philosophy, music, optics, and invented cryptanalysis. The frequency analysis he laid out in Baghdad broke every cipher humanity had built; no system resistant to it would emerge for seven centuries. The same hand tuned an oud, translated Aristotle, and read enciphered letters.

The same "al-" is everywhere in Portugal, where the studio works: Alfama, Algarve, Alentejo, Almada; quiet traces of the Arabic-speaking world he came from.

Eleven centuries later, his work on ciphers is the foundation of every smart contract the studio deploys. The studio borrowed the name in tribute.

## Team

Two cities. One studio.

### Münevver Aslan — Digital Product Designer

Istanbul · Lisbon. Münevver brings a multidisciplinary eye to every project, spanning brand systems, interaction design, and the fine line between clarity and character. Born in Istanbul, now based between Lisbon and wherever the work takes her.

### Ferit Tunçer — Lead & Software Engineer

Lisbon. The engineering half of al-Kindi and founder of the studio. Ten years building production software with deep focus on Ethereum: smart contract development, security review, and gas-sensitive protocol work. Cypherpunk by orientation, computer science by training. Based in Lisbon.
